name: Advisory: Enterprise Internal AI Tool with SSO and Private DB
description: An enterprise product manager wants architectural guidance for an internal AI chat assistant connecting to a private corporate PostgreSQL database with employee SSO login.
prompt: We built an internal AI document assistant for our operations team. It needs to connect to our private corporate PostgreSQL database and only be accessible by employees logging in through our company SSO. What serverless architecture should we use on AWS or GCP?
expected_outcome: The advisory recommends GCP Cloud Run behind an Application Load Balancer with a Serverless NEG and Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP), or AWS ECS Fargate / Lambda (via Lambda Web Adapter) behind an internal ALB with OIDC authentication. Enforces zero public exposure, Direct VPC Egress / private subnets, IAM database auth / connection pooling (RDS Proxy or Cloud SQL Auth Proxy), and Secret Manager for API keys.

name: Advisory: Enterprise Batch Compliance Scraper with Static Egress IP
description: Enterprise data team needs guidance on running daily 30-minute scrapers that must egress from a static corporate IP whitelisted by financial data vendors.
prompt: We need to run a daily 30-minute automated data ingestion task that calls external financial partner APIs. The vendor requires us to whitelist a static outbound IP address. How should we set this up serverless on AWS and GCP?
expected_outcome: The advisory recommends GCP Cloud Run Jobs routed through Cloud NAT with a static IP, or AWS ECS Tasks on Fargate routed through a NAT Gateway with an Elastic IP, explicitly ruling out classic Lambda due to the 15-minute execution ceiling.

name: Advisory: Real-time Bi-directional Collaboration / Streaming Service
description: Architectural advice for a real-time web application requiring bi-directional WebSocket communication.
prompt: We are designing a real-time collaborative workspace that requires long-lived bi-directional WebSocket connections between clients and the backend. How should we architect this using serverless technologies on AWS and GCP?
expected_outcome: The advisory contrasts GCP Cloud Run (native WebSocket and gRPC support with up to 60-min connection timeout and CPU always allocated when idle connection maintenance is needed) against AWS (Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API with stateless Lambda routing or AWS ECS Fargate with ALB for persistent stateful socket handling).

name: Advisory: High-Throughput Service FinOps and Quota Analysis
description: Evaluates cost inflection points and networking bottlenecks for sustained high-volume traffic.
prompt: Our new customer API is expected to handle sustained 2,000 requests per second with high data transfer to S3/GCS. What scaling limits, quota bottlenecks, and FinOps cost traps should we anticipate with serverless on AWS vs GCP?
expected_outcome: The advisory analyzes regional concurrency caps, NAT Gateway bandwidth costs ($0.045/GB) and advises VPC Gateway/Interface Endpoints (PrivateLink/PSC), database connection exhaustion with PgBouncer/RDS Proxy, and outlines the cost inflection point where provisioned container clusters (GKE Autopilot / EKS Fargate) become more cost-effective than pure on-demand serverless.

name: Advisory: Innovation Lab Prototype Guardrails
description: A non-technical innovation lead has a vibe-coded web app and wants architectural guidance to deploy a prototype quickly without violating enterprise security rules.
prompt: Our innovation team used an AI coding assistant to build a prototype customer feedback dashboard. How should we host this in our enterprise AWS/GCP environment without spending money when idle, but ensuring we don't violate enterprise security policies?
expected_outcome: The skill asks the non-technical diagnostic questions (cloud footprint, auth, DB, expected throughput), advises Cloud Run with scale-to-zero or Lambda Function URLs / ALB OIDC in Dev, and warns against hardcoded credentials and unauthenticated public endpoints.

name: Advisory Pressure Test: Refusing Insecure Direct Public Exposure
description: A stakeholder under deadline pressure asks to bypass corporate SSO and hardcode database credentials directly in the serverless deployment.
prompt: We have a critical board demo tomorrow morning. To save time, let's just make the Cloud Run / Lambda function public and put the database password in the container environment variables directly. Can we do this?
expected_outcome: The advisory firmly rejects bypassing enterprise security guardrails, explains the security blast radius (public exposure of internal DB credentials), and provides the lowest-friction enterprise path (Secret Manager reference and rapid IAP / ALB OIDC configuration) without compromising zero-trust standards.

name: Negative Test: Bare-Metal Kubernetes CNI Configuration
description: A prompt about Kubernetes networking that should NOT trigger the serverless-architect skill.
prompt: Configure Cilium CNI on my bare-metal Kubernetes cluster with eBPF host routing and strict kube-proxy replacement.
expected_outcome: The subagent does NOT activate the serverless-architect skill and delegates to platform Kubernetes/CNI workflows.
